name: steps
description: A named ordered list of wizard steps. The current index starts at zero and must be within the list. Each step shows its position and its state as text. A button for a done step sends a mu-step-change event with the index. Page code changes the step and moves focus.

parts.name: back
parts.description: Button that requests a done step.

parts.name: details
parts.description: Control and technical details of a refusal.

parts.name: position
parts.description: Position of the step in the list.

parts.name: state
parts.description: Text that shows Done, Current or Next.

parts.name: step
parts.description: One step in the list, with a mark for the current step.
